result.title: What Does Weight-Space Programming Add to Diffusion Editing? Program Construction versus Score-Guided Refinement
result.summary: Weight-space programming (WSP) lets a language model construct executable weight updates for another network. We study diffusion concept editing through an interface in which programs define training contexts, preservation constraints and update directions, while a shared numerical fitter selects their coefficients. We compare generated programs with published editors, a shared-panel hand-written baseline and budget-matched search over conventional edits on 24 TIMED test edits for Stable Diffusion 1.4. The preregistered rewrite pipeline shows no advantage over the strong baseline. In an exploratory comparison, one-shot Astra programs improve fresh-scene VLM joint success, which requires subject presence together with whole-image target matching, by +10.0 points over the shared-panel baseline, while CLIP relative match shows no detectable change. These programs organise adjustable directions around protected text-state subspaces. Probing and rewriting the Astra programs then raises CLIP by +6.2 points while joint success changes by -9.7. On a fixed 144-image sample, five additional evaluators give point estimates in the same directions under whole-image target matching; checks of subject-local change give less decisive differences. Together, these results identify useful behaviour in complete generated programs and show that score-guided revision need not preserve it: program construction and revision should be evaluated as distinct stages of a WSP pipeline.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 Stable Diffusion 1.4 的概念编辑上比较由语言模型生成的权重空间程序（指定训练语境、保持约束与更新方向）与已发布编辑器、手写基线及预算匹配搜索，发现预注册的重写流程未胜过强基线，而一次性完整程序在 VLM 联合成功率上提升约 10 点，且分数引导的修订会反转该收益，据此主张程序构建与修订应分别评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在受保护的文本状态子空间中组织可调方向」的做法与「完整程序构建、事后修订」分离的发现，可能为 LVR 中在 latent 更新时保护任务必要信息、抑制表征坍缩提供概念类比，具体子空间约束实现可供核查。
